name: catalyst_tps_pure_cage_applicability_baseline_v1
purpose: Provide a clean pure-EnzymeCAGE external baseline for legacy TPS practical R2E without repairing EnzymeCAGE-native input failures.

baseline.protein_features: archived native EnzymeCAGE GVP+pocket ESM features
baseline.retrieval_gate_identity: EnzymeCAGE retrieve.py algorithm reproduction: Top-10 similar-reaction candidate retrieval semantics; archived TPS gate artifact, not claimed to be an author-original TPS file

applicability.rule: Recover only three reactions whose historical source SMILES were missing but current Rhea registry supplies an ordinary valid representation. Do not repair the 48 reactions that remain outside EnzymeCAGE native reaction processing. Do not impute the 12 proteins lacking native structure/pocket features.
